gloss: as good as, equivalent to, practically

definitions.gloss: as good as, equivalent to, practically
definitions.explanation: Used as a suffix to indicate that something is equivalent to or practically the same as the preceding noun.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぼろ→ぼろ：00019_boro⟧{同然|どうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧だ。
⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{同然|どうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{死|し}んだ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{同然|どうぜん}だ。

notes:
{同然|どうぜん} attaches to nouns, adjectives, or verb phrases as a suffix meaning "as good as" or "practically equivalent to." It expresses that something is not literally X but so close as to be virtually the same.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{同然|どうぜん}: practically free
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧{同然|どうぜん}: as good as new
- ⟦ぼろ→ぼろ：00019_boro⟧{同然|どうぜん}: practically in tatters
- ⟦{死|し}んだ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{同然|どうぜん}: as good as dead (after a verb, ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{同然|どうぜん}: ⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{同然|どうぜん}, as good as won)
- ⟦{廃墟|はいきょ}→廃墟：12453_haikyo⟧{同然|どうぜん}: practically a ruin
When modifying a noun, {同然|どうぜん} is followed by ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{同然|どうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ (a price that's practically free).

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + {然|ぜん} (so, thus) — literally "the same as."
